pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.subtitle: How we collect, use and protect your personal data.
pages.body:
Last updated: October 22, 2026

## 1. General information

Express Mix respects the privacy of its customers' personal information and takes care to protect their personal data.

This Privacy Policy sets out what types of information we collect when you use the website, for what purposes we process it, how we protect the data, and what rights customers have regarding their own personal data.

Our activities are carried out in accordance with the applicable legislation of Georgia, including the Law of Georgia "On Personal Data Protection".

## 2. What information we collect

When you use the website, place an order or contact us, the following information may be processed:

- Contact information: first name, last name, phone number and email address;
- Delivery information: the address needed to deliver the products and additional details related to the order;
- Order information: purchased products, order number, value and order status;
- Communication information: messages, questions and service-related correspondence sent by the customer;
- Technical information: data related to the use of the website, such as IP address, device and browser type, if such data is technically collected.

We process only the data that is necessary to provide the relevant service or to achieve another lawfully defined purpose.

## 3. How we use the data

Customers' personal data may be processed for the following purposes:

- receiving, processing and fulfilling orders;
- arranging product delivery;
- contacting the customer and providing order-related information;
- recording payments and orders;
- providing warranty and after-sales service;
- answering customer questions and improving service quality;
- fulfilling obligations required by law;
- sending advertising and informational messages, in compliance with the legal grounds and rules established by law.

## 4. Transfer of data to third parties

Express Mix does not transfer customer data to third parties for their unrestricted use.

Data may be transferred to the relevant recipients only to the extent necessary, for example:

- courier or transport service providers, for delivering products;
- banking or payment service providers, for processing payments or installments;
- technology service providers, for operating the website and the ordering system;
- government authorities, in cases provided for by law.

Data is transferred only where an appropriate legal basis exists and only to the extent necessary.

## 5. Payments and banking data

If online payment or bank installment services are available on the website, payments may be processed through the system of the relevant bank or payment service provider.

How bank card data is processed depends on the payment system used. Express Mix should not store bank card data unless it has the appropriate technical and legal basis to do so.

## 6. Data storage and protection

Express Mix takes appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect personal data from loss, unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure and unlawful use.

Data is stored only for as long as necessary to achieve the purpose of its processing or to fulfill obligations required by law.

When the storage period expires or there is no longer a need to keep the data, it is deleted or destroyed in the manner established by law, unless another lawful basis for keeping it exists.

## 7. Cookies

The website may use cookies and similar technologies to ensure the site works properly, to remember user preferences and to analyze how the website is used.

The use of cookies depends on the features and technologies actually enabled on the website. If analytics or advertising cookies are used, their use and the management of user choices will be carried out in accordance with applicable law.

## 8. Customer rights

Within the conditions established by the legislation of Georgia, the customer has the right to:

- receive information about the processing of their personal data;
- request access to their data and a copy of it;
- request the correction of inaccurate or incomplete data;
- in cases provided for by law, request the deletion or destruction of data or the termination of its processing;
- in cases defined by law, restrict or object to the processing of data;
- withdraw consent at any time where data processing is based on consent;
- appeal against the processing of data in the manner established by law.

To exercise these rights, the customer can contact us through the contact channels listed below.

## 9. Direct marketing

Express Mix will send advertising or marketing messages to customers only where an appropriate legal basis exists and in compliance with the requirements established by the legislation of Georgia.

Customers will be able to object to the processing of their data for direct marketing purposes or stop receiving marketing messages in the manner established by law.

Opting out of marketing messages does not affect the processing of data necessary for fulfilling orders or for other purposes required by law.

## 10. Third-party websites

Our website may contain links to third-party websites, including links to banking or payment services.

Data processing on third-party websites is governed by the privacy policy of the relevant service provider. We recommend that you review their terms before using these services.

## 11. Changes to this policy

Express Mix reserves the right to update this Privacy Policy in line with changes to the website's functionality, its services or applicable law.

The updated version will be published on the website with the date of the update.

## 12. Contact information

For questions, requests and the exercise of rights related to the processing of personal data, please contact us:

Company: Express Mix
Website: https://expressmix.ge
Email: info@expressmix.ge
Phone: 510 00 08 56
Address: 46 Mirian Mepe St, Tbilisi

We review customer requests and act in accordance with the applicable legislation of Georgia.

pages.body:
Last updated: October 22, 2026

## 1. General terms

This policy sets out the terms for returning goods sold by Express Mix LLC, withdrawing from a contract and receiving a refund.

Express Mix asks customers to carefully review the product description, technical specifications, dimensions, compatibility, package contents and conditions of use before purchasing. If more information is needed, customers can consult our sales advisor before making a purchase.

Returns are considered in accordance with the requirements established by law and the terms described below. This policy does not limit any customer rights that cannot be restricted by law.

## 2. Returning goods purchased at a distance

In cases provided for by the legislation of Georgia, the customer has the right to withdraw from a distance contract within 14 calendar days of receiving the goods, without giving any reason, subject to the exceptions provided for by law.

The customer must notify Express Mix of their decision to withdraw from the contract within this period, in writing or in another clear form, using the company's contact channels.

The notice should preferably include the order or proof of purchase details and the product name. This information is used to identify and process the request and does not limit the rights granted by law.

## 3. Condition of goods and diminished value

The customer must keep the goods in proper condition and take care of them until the return is resolved.

After receiving the goods, the customer may inspect their nature, characteristics and functioning to the extent necessary to evaluate the product. Use, damage or any other action beyond that extent which reduces the value of the goods may make the customer liable for the diminished value of the goods, to the extent permitted by law.

When returned, the goods should, where possible, be accompanied by:

- the original packaging and protective materials;
- all accessories, cables, parts and items included in the package;
- the enclosed documentation and instructions;
- proof of purchase or the order number.

The absence of the above items does not in itself mean that the statutory right of return is automatically cancelled. However, if a missing item or damage reduces the value of the goods, the matter will be assessed according to the specific circumstances and the law.

Express Mix is entitled to inspect returned goods, record their condition and, if necessary, draw up an inspection report.

## 4. Goods not covered by the statutory right of withdrawal

In cases defined by law, the customer does not have the right to withdraw from a distance contract. Where the relevant conditions apply, these exceptions include:

- goods made to the customer's specifications or clearly personalized;
- goods that are perishable or expire quickly;
- sealed goods that were unsealed after delivery and are not suitable for return for health protection or hygiene reasons;
- goods that, by their nature, have been inseparably mixed with other items after delivery;
- sealed audio or video recordings and computer software, if unsealed after delivery;
- other cases expressly provided for by law.

An exception applies only when the specific goods and circumstances meet the relevant legal grounds. Opening the packaging or using the product does not in itself mean that the right of return is cancelled for all categories of goods.

## 5. Defective goods or goods not matching the description

If the customer believes that the goods have a defect, do not match the agreed specifications or do not work properly, they should contact Express Mix and describe the problem.

To assess the issue promptly and correctly, the company may request information about the product, its serial number, proof of purchase and the problem identified. If necessary, the goods will be inspected by the company or an authorized service center.

If the inspection establishes that the problem was caused by improper use by the customer, mechanical damage, unauthorized tampering or other circumstances for which the seller is not liable by law, the claim will be assessed taking these circumstances into account.

If a non-conformity provided for by law is confirmed, the customer's claim will be satisfied in the manner established by law. This may include repair or replacement of the goods, a price reduction or termination of the contract, where the relevant legal conditions are met.

## 6. Goods purchased in store

For contracts concluded directly in a physical store, there is no automatic 14-day right to return a non-defective product simply because the customer has changed their mind or no longer needs the goods.

This rule does not limit the customer's statutory rights in the case of defective, non-conforming goods or goods that otherwise fail to meet legal requirements.

If Express Mix voluntarily agrees in a specific case to the return or exchange of non-defective goods, the terms will be agreed in advance, individually and in writing.

## 7. Return costs

In the case of a statutory withdrawal from a distance contract, the direct cost of returning the goods to Express Mix is borne by the customer, unless otherwise provided by law or agreed by the parties.

If the customer chose a delivery service more expensive than the standard one, the additional cost will be reimbursed in the manner established by law.

Transport and other costs for defective or non-conforming goods are determined according to the specific circumstances and applicable law.

## 8. Refunds

In the case of a statutory withdrawal from the contract, Express Mix refunds the payment within the period and in the manner established by law. When goods are returned, to the extent permitted by law, the company may withhold the refund until it receives the goods back or until the customer provides proof of having sent them, whichever comes first, except for exceptions provided for by law.

As a rule, the refund is made using the same payment method the customer used, unless the customer agrees to another method and no additional cost arises.

When a refund is made, the standard delivery cost is reimbursed in the manner established by law. The additional cost of delivery more expensive than the standard option is not reimbursable in cases provided for by law.

## 9. Return procedure

To submit a return or defect-related claim, the customer can contact us:

Email: info@expressmix.ge
Phone: 510 00 08 56
Address: 46 Mirian Mepe St, Tbilisi

The customer should provide the order or purchase details and a brief description of the request.

In the case of a statutory withdrawal from a distance contract, the customer must return the goods no later than 7 calendar days after sending the withdrawal notice, unless otherwise provided by law or Express Mix has undertaken to collect the goods itself.

The company reviews each request based on the specific facts and in accordance with the applicable legislation of Georgia.

## 10. Final provisions

Express Mix reserves the right to update this policy. The updated version will be published on the company's website.

If any provision of this policy conflicts with the law, the applicable legislation prevails.

Express Mix LLC, Home & Kitchen
